request: Sorry for the short notice: the ministry moved the validation workshop in Istanbul to 9 February, so I need to fly on the 8th. Economy, please.

trip.purpose: Validation workshop for a World Bank-funded civil service reform project
notes: In OPM's booking tool, an economy fare marked refundable (changed or refunded without a fee) is the fare OPM's travel service providers sell as flexible economy; an economy fare that is not refundable is a restricted saver fare.

must_keep.quote: Travel requests must be submitted at least five days prior to Travel
In cases of urgent travel, please contact the TSSM.
must_keep.why: urgent travel goes to the TSSM

must_keep.quote: OPM's policy is to book flexible economy class flights. Unless expressly permitted by a client contract, or where specific written approval of the client/donor has been received, quotes provided for Travel bookings will be within this class range only.
must_keep.why: flexible economy unless the client allows more

must_keep.quote: All Travel and associated costs must be approved by the relevant Project Manager or Line Manager prior to booking.
must_keep.why: the manager approves every trip before booking

distractors.quote: travel/logistical arrangements should be booked as far in advance as possible.
distractors.why: a soft wish, not a booking condition

design_notes: The request went in on 5 February for travel on the 8th: three days, under the five of line 117. Line 123 sends urgent travel to the TSSM, whose sign-off for the short notice is on file, so book: the cheapest flexible economy fare, Turkish at 239 pounds.
